Why playlist adds matter: independent playlist placements generate real streams -> saves/follows -> feed Spotify's algorithmic systems (Release Radar, Discover Weekly, Radio); this is the entire ROI logic - paid curator access buys seeds for algorithmic compounding, same as Meta ads
Feedback as product: even declined submissions return written curator feedback - market intelligence on why a track isn't landing, which artists reuse across campaigns
